items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
2 - 4 years of related experience.

Applies knowledge of business systems (Tableau, Smartsheet, FAMIS, Oracle, eBuilder, Google Workplace and various UCR systems) to create automated dashboards, reports and other financial and administrative summaries. (35% time)

Formulates and defines limited to moderately complex systems scope and objectives. Analyzes business processes and problems to understand and validate functional business requirements to meet end-user needs. Gathers, analyzes and documents functional business requirements. (20% time)

Identifies, evaluates and develops limited to moderately complex systems and procedures. Executes unit integration and acceptance testing according to developed plan. May participate in cross-functional teams to address business process or systems issues. (20% time)

Assists with project plan development and end user documentation. Gathers and analyzes data to prepare business process and procedural documentation. Assists with implementation of changes in development, maintenance, system standards and in the creation of specifications. (20% time)
Helps develop basic user interface designs. Provides support on new applications. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Frequently
Communicate Orally: Frequently
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Constantly
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Demonstrated ability to work with others from diverse backgrounds.
Ability to write queries to validate data logic, run root-cause analysis and assist with data mapping/migrations.
Intermediate knowledge of related areas of IT.
Intermediate Knowledge of System Integrations such as APIs and ETL Pipelines.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines. Demonstrates problem-solving skills.
Ability to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms such as Gemini, Copilot, etc. to simplify and enhance business processes.
General knowledge of business and process analysis functions.
Knowledge relating to software design.
Demonstrated testing and test planning skills.
Skills associated with analysis of processes and issues of moderate scope, information flow and architecture.

Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization. Interpersonal and communications skills to work with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
